WEATHERBALL.Description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

ECHOEDVOICE.Description: The user hits the target with an echoing voice. If used every turn, it is more powerful.

FAKEOUT.Description: This attack hits first and makes targets flinch. It can only be used on the user's first turn.

FALSESWIPE.Description: A restrained attack that leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

PAYDAY.Description: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.

POUND.Description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

QUICKATTACK.Description: The user slams the target at a tremendous speed. It is sure to strike first.

SCRATCH.Description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

SNORE.Description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. It may also make the target flinch.

DOUBLEHIT.Description: The user slams the target with a tail, vine, or tentacle. The target is hit twice.

FEINT.Description: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It lifts the effects of said moves.

TAILSLAP.Description: The user strikes the target with its tail. It hits the Pokémon two to five times in a row.

RAGE.Description: While the move is in use, the user's rage raises the Attack stat when the user is hit.

RAPIDSPIN.Description: A spin attack that eliminates moves such as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes. Also raises user's Speed.

SPIKECANNON.Description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times.

COMETPUNCH.Description: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

FURYSWIPES.Description: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

BARRAGE.Description: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

BIND.Description: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind the foe for four to five turns.

DOUBLESLAP.Description: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

FURYATTACK.Description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

WRAP.Description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

CONSTRICT.Description: The target is attacked with creeping tentacles or vines. It can lower the target's Speed.

BIDE.Description: The user endures for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

CRUSHGRIP.Description: The target is crushed. The greater the target's HP, the more powerful the attack.

ENDEAVOR.Description: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

FLAIL.Description: The user flails about to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

FRUSTRATION.Description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

GUILLOTINE.Description: A vicious attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

HIDDENPOWER.Description: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

HORNDRILL.Description: The user stabs the target with a rotating horn. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

NATURALGIFT.Description: The user draws power from its held Berry. The Berry determines the type and power.

PRESENT.Description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes.

RETURN.Description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

SONICBOOM.Description: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

SPITUP.Description: The power stored by Stockpile is released. The more power stored, the greater the damage.

SUPERFANG.Description: The user bites hard on the target with sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

TRUMPCARD.Description: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.

WRINGOUT.Description: The user wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack's power.

ACUPRESSURE.Description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

AFTERYOU.Description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

ASSIST.Description: The user randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

ATTRACT.Description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated.

BATONPASS.Description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

BELLYDRUM.Description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

BESTOW.Description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.

BLOCK.Description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

CAMOUFLAGE.Description: The user's type is changed depending on its environment.

CAPTIVATE.Description: Opposing Pokémon of the opposite gender are charmed, and their Sp. Atk stat harshly lowered.

CHARM.Description: The user gazes at the target, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

CONVERSION.Description: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

CONVERSION2.Description: The user changes to a resistant type of the attack the opponent used last.

COPYCAT.Description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it.

DEFENSECURL.Description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

DISABLE.Description: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

DOUBLETEAM.Description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

ENCORE.Description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

ENDURE.Description: The user endures any attack. Its chance of failing is greater if used in succession.

ENTRAINMENT.Description: The user dances and compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability identical.

FLASH.Description: The user's flashing light cuts the target's accuracy. It can be used to illuminate caves.

FOCUSENERGY.Description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

FOLLOWME.Description: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

FORESIGHT.Description: Identifies an evasive or Ghost-type target.

GLARE.Description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

GROWL.Description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stat.

GROWTH.Description: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.

HARDEN.Description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

HEALBELL.Description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all party Pokémon.

HELPINGHAND.Description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

HOWL.Description: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

LEER.Description: Leers with sharp eyes. The opposing team's Defense stats are reduced.

LOCKON.Description: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not miss.

LOVELYKISS.Description: The user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.

LUCKYCHANT.Description: The user chants toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits.

MEFIRST.Description: The user cuts ahead of the target to use its intended move with greater power.

MEANLOOK.Description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

METRONOME.Description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

MILKDRINK.Description: The user restores its HP by up to half of its maximum. May be used in the field to heal.

MIMIC.Description: The user copies the target's last move and adds it to its move-set until it is switched out.

MINDREADER.Description: The user senses the target's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack hits.

MINIMIZE.Description: The user compresses its body to look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

MOONLIGHT.Description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

MORNINGSUN.Description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

NATUREPOWER.Description: An attack that makes use of the user's environment.

ODORSLEUTH.Description: Enables Ghost-types  to be hit by Normal and Fighting-type moves.

PAINSPLIT.Description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then shares the combined HP with the target.

PERISHSONG.Description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

PROTECT.Description: It lets the user evade a move. Its chance of failing rises if used in succession.

PSYCHUP.Description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

RECOVER.Description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

RECYCLE.Description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

REFLECTTYPE.Description: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.

REFRESH.Description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

ROAR.Description: The target is replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

SAFEGUARD.Description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

SCARYFACE.Description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

SCREECH.Description: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.

SHARPEN.Description: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

SHELLSMASH.Description: The user's defensive stats are lowered but its offensive stats are sharply raised.

SIMPLEBEAM.Description: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.

SING.Description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

SKETCH.Description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target.

SLACKOFF.Description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

SLEEPTALK.Description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

SMOKESCREEN.Description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

SOFTBOILED.Description: The user restores its own HP by half of its maximum. May be used in the field to heal.

SPLASH.Description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all.

STOCKPILE.Description: The user stores power and raises its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used thrice.

SUBSTITUTE.Description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

SUPERSONIC.Description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

SWAGGER.Description: The user confuses the target. It also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

SWALLOW.Description: The power stored using Stockpile is absorbed to heal HP. Storing more heals more HP.

SWEETKISS.Description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

SWEETSCENT.Description: A sweet scent that harshly lowers the opposing team's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon.

SWORDSDANCE.Description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

TAILWHIP.Description: The user wags its tail cutely, lowering foes' Defense stat.

TEETERDANCE.Description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

TICKLE.Description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

TRANSFORM.Description: The user transforms into a clone of its target.

WHIRLWIND.Description: The foe is blown away to be replaced by another Pokémon or flee.

WISH.Description: One turn after it is used, the target's HP is restored by half of its maximum HP.

WORKUP.Description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

YAWN.Description: The user lets loose a yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

GUNKSHOT.Description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may poison the target.

SLUDGEWAVE.Description: It swamps the area near the user with giant sludge waves. It may also poison those hit.

SLUDGEBOMB.Description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

POISONJAB.Description: The target is jabbed with a tentacle or arm covered in poison. It may poison the target.

CROSSPOISON.Description: A slash with poisonous blades that can leave targets poisoned. Critical hits land easier.

SLUDGE.Description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

VENOSHOCK.Description: The user drenches the target in a poison. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.

CLEARSMOG.Description: The user throws a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

POISONFANG.Description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

POISONTAIL.Description: The user attacks with its tail. It may poison the target. Critical hits land easier.

ACID.Description: The opposing team is attacked with acid and may also lower the targets' Sp.Def stats.

ACIDSPRAY.Description: The user spits fluid thats melts the target. It harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def.

SMOG.Description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

POISONSTING.Description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

ACIDARMOR.Description: The user alters its cell structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense.

COIL.Description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack, Defense, and Accuracy.

GASTROACID.Description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. This eliminates the target's Ability.

POISONGAS.Description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed on opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

POISONPOWDER.Description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

TOXIC.Description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

TOXICSPIKES.Description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes. They poison opponents that switch into battle.

PSYCHOBOOST.Description: The user hits the target at full power. The attack harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

DREAMEATER.Description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused.

FUTURESIGHT.Description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

PSYSTRIKE.Description: The user creates an odd psychic wave to hit the target. This attack does physical damage.

PSYCHIC.Description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

EXTRASENSORY.Description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

PSYSHOCK.Description: The user creates an odd psychic wave to hit the target. This attack does physical damage.

ZENHEADBUTT.Description: The user focuses power to its head and hits the target. It may make the target flinch.

LUSTERPURGE.Description: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

MISTBALL.Description: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may lower the target's Sp. Atk.

PSYCHOCUT.Description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land easier.

SYNCHRONOISE.Description: Using a shock wave, the user inflicts damage on Pokémon of the same type.

PSYBEAM.Description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

HEARTSTAMP.Description: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act. It may make the target flinch.

CONFUSION.Description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

MIRRORCOAT.Description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage.

PSYWAVE.Description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

STOREDPOWER.Description: The user attacks the target. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

AGILITY.Description: The user lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

ALLYSWITCH.Description: The user teleports and switches places with its ally. Its chance of failing rises if used in succession.

AMNESIA.Description: The user temporarily empties its mind. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

BARRIER.Description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

CALMMIND.Description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

COSMICPOWER.Description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

GRAVITY.Description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

GUARDSPLIT.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target's.

GUARDSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

HEALBLOCK.Description: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using anything that recovers HP.

HEALPULSE.Description: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.

HEALINGWISH.Description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

HEARTSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

HYPNOSIS.Description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

IMPRISON.Description: The user prevents the opponent from using moves known by the user.

KINESIS.Description: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target's accuracy.

LIGHTSCREEN.Description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

LUNARDANCE.Description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

MAGICCOAT.Description: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

MAGICROOM.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

MEDITATE.Description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

MIRACLEEYE.Description: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. Ignores evasion.

POWERSPLIT.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target's.

POWERSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

POWERTRICK.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

PSYCHOSHIFT.Description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

REFLECT.Description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

REST.Description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

ROLEPLAY.Description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.

SKILLSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

TELEKINESIS.Description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

TELEPORT.Description: The user switches places with a different Pokémon instantly, using telekinetic power.

TRICK.Description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

TRICKROOM.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

WONDERROOM.Description: For five turns, Pokémon's Def and Sp. Def stats are swapped.

HEADSMASH.Description: The user attacks the target with a full-power headbutt. The user takes terrible damage.

ROCKWRECKER.Description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

STONEEDGE.Description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

ROCKSLIDE.Description: Boulders are hurled at the opposing team. The targets may flinch.

POWERGEM.Description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

ANCIENTPOWER.Description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

ROCKTHROW.Description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

ROCKTOMB.Description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

SMACKDOWN.Description: The user throws a stone or projectile at the opponent. Flying Pokémon will fall to the ground.

ROLLOUT.Description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

ROCKBLAST.Description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

ROCKPOLISH.Description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

SANDSTORM.Description: A sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

STEALTHROCK.Description: A trap of levitating stones is laid around the opponent. It hurts Pokémon on the switch.

WIDEGUARD.Description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

DOOMDESIRE.Description: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

IRONTAIL.Description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

METEORMASH.Description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user's Attack.

FLASHCANNON.Description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

IRONHEAD.Description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

STEELWING.Description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

MIRRORSHOT.Description: The user looses a flash of energy at the target. It might lower the target's accuracy.

MAGNETBOMB.Description: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

GEARGRIND.Description: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

METALCLAW.Description: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

BULLETPUNCH.Description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

GYROBALL.Description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

HEAVYSLAM.Description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. Damage varies with the user's weight.

METALBURST.Description: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.

AUTOTOMIZE.Description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

IRONDEFENSE.Description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

METALSOUND.Description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

SHIFTGEAR.Description: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

HYDROCANNON.Description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

WATERSPOUT.Description: The user spouts water to damage the opposing team. Damage varies with the user's HP.

HYDROPUMP.Description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

MUDDYWATER.Description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

SURF.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

AQUATAIL.Description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

CRABHAMMER.Description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

DIVE.Description: Dives on the first turn and attacks on the second. It can be used to dive deep in the ocean.

SCALD.Description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

WATERFALL.Description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

RAZORSHELL.Description: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This might lower the target's Def. stat.

BRINE.Description: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

BUBBLEBEAM.Description: A spray of bubbles is launched at the target. It may also lower its Speed stat.

OCTAZOOKA.Description: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target's face. It may lower the target's accuracy.

WATERPULSE.Description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

WATERPLEDGE.Description: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, a rainbow appears.

AQUAJET.Description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

WATERGUN.Description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

CLAMP.Description: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user's very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

WHIRLPOOL.Description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

BUBBLE.Description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets' Speed stats.

AQUARING.Description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

RAINDANCE.Description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

SOAK.Description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

WATERSPORT.Description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

WITHDRAW.Description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

AROMATICMIST.Description: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of ally Pokémon with a mysterious aroma.

BABYDOLLEYES.Description: Using its baby-doll eyes, the user lowers the opponent's Atk stat. It always goes first.

BELCH.Description: The user lets out a damaging belch on the target. This move fails unless the user has eaten a Berry.

BOOMBURST.Description: The user attacks everything around it with the power of a terrible, explosive sound.

CONFIDE.Description: The user tells the target a secret, and lowers its Sp. Atk stat.

CRAFTYSHIELD.Description: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.

DAZZLINGGLEAM.Description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

DISARMINGVOICE.Description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. It never misses.

DRAININGKISS.Description: The user steals the target's energy with a kiss. Over half of the damage goes to the user's HP.

EERIEIMPULSE.Description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

ELECTRICTERRAIN.Description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Grounded Pokémon can't fall asleep.

ELECTRIFY.Description: Electrifies the target and makes its move on that turn become Electric-type.

FAIRYLOCK.Description: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

FAIRYWIND.Description: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

FELLSTINGER.Description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.

FLOWERSHIELD.Description: The user raises the Defense stat of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

FLYINGPRESS.Description: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.

FORESTSCURSE.Description: The user puts a forest curse on the target. Afflicted targets are now Grass type as well.

FREEZEDRY.Description: The user rapidly cools the target. It's super-effective on Water types.

GEOMANCY.Description: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

GRASSYTERRAIN.Description: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. Grounded Pokémon restore HP every turn.

INFESTATION.Description: The target is infested for four to five turns. It can't flee during this time.

IONDELUGE.Description: The user disperses charged particles, which change Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

KINGSSHIELD.Description: The user is protected from damage. Direct contact lowers any attacker's Attack stat.

LANDSWRATH.Description: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.

MAGNETICFLUX.Description: The user manipulates magnetic fields. This raises the Def and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus.

MATBLOCK.Description: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.

MISTYTERRAIN.Description: The user covers the ground with mist for five turns. Grounded Pokémon are immune to status conditions.

MOONBLAST.Description: The user attacks with moon power. It might lower the target's Sp. Atk.

MYSTICALFIRE.Description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. It lowers the target's Sp. Atk.

NOBLEROAR.Description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Atk. and Sp. Atk.

NUZZLE.Description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks. It paralyzes the target.

OBLIVIONWING.Description: The user absorbs its target's HP. The HP is restored by over half of the damage.

PARABOLICCHARGE.Description: The user attacks everything around it. HP is restored by half of the damage.

PARTINGSHOT.Description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Atk and Sp. Atk. Then it switches out.

PETALBLIZZARD.Description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

PHANTOMFORCE.Description: The user vanishes, then strikes on the next turn. It strikes even if the target protects itself.

PLAYNICE.Description: The user and the target become friends. This lowers the target's Atk.

PLAYROUGH.Description: The user plays rough and attacks. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

ARENITEWALL.Description: Creates a wall of sand that reduces the power of super-effective moves. Used only in a sandstorm.

QUICKSILVERSPEAR.Description: The user hurls a spear of quicksilver to pin the target. This drops its Speed and deals constant damage.

SOLARFLARE.Description: The user tackles the opponent, engulfed in incredible flames. It may raise the user's Attack.

HOARFROSTMOON.Description: The user releases an icy, crescent burst at the opponents. It may raise the user's Special Attack.

HEXINGSLASH.Description: A relentless attack using cursed tendrils. Drains HP and has a chance to poison.

MIRRORBEAM.Description: The user fires a gleaming beam of the most effective reflected type or Steel.

INJECTION.Description: The user drains the target of its data and life force. Restores 50% of damage dealt as HP.

CAUTERIZE.Description: Uses a burning flames to sear the target. Cauterizes and heals ally Pokémon instead.

PROBOPOG.Description: Please don't hack it in, it's a bad move on its own, don't be weirdchamp

SUPERSONICSKYSTRIKE.Description: The user soars up with its Z-Power and plummets toward the target at full speed.

TECTONICRAGE.Description: The user burrows deep into the ground and slams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power.

HYDROVORTEX.Description: The user creates a huge whirling current using its Z-Power to swallow the target with full force.

BLOOMDOOM.Description: The user collects energy from plants using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force.

SHATTEREDPSYCHE.Description: The user controls the target with its Z-Power and hurts the target with full force.

SUBZEROSLAMMER.Description: The user dramatically drops the temperature using its Z-Power and freezes the target with full force.

DEVASTATINGDRAKE.Description: The user materializes its aura using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force.

BLACKHOLEECLIPSE.Description: The user gathers dark energy using its Z-Power and sucks the target into it.

TWINKLETACKLE.Description: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target.

STOKEDSPARKSURFER.Description: The user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force and leaves it with paralysis.

SINISTERARROWRAID.Description: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows and shoots the target with full force.

MALICIOUSMOONSAULT.Description: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body and crashes into the target with full force.

OCEANICOPERETTA.Description: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of water and attacks the target with full force.

EXTREMEEVOBOOST.Description: The user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts all of its stats sharply.

CATASTROPIKA.Description: The user, Pikachu, summons a huge amount of electricity and pounces on its target with full force.

PULVERIZINGPANCAKE.Description: The user, Snorlax, moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.

SOULSTEALING7STARSTRIKE.Description: The user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.

LETSSNUGGLEFOREVER.Description: The user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.

SPLINTEREDSTORMSHARDS.Description: The user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force and negates the effect on the battlefield.

SEARINGSUNRAZESMASH.Description: The user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move ignores the target's Ability.

MENACINGMOONRAZEMAELSTROM.Description: The user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move ignores the target's Ability.

ORBITALRING.Description: The user endures for the rest of the turn, redirecting all attacks towards itself.

VENGEFULNUKE.Description: A wrathful attack that increases its damage for every statboost on the target. Ignores stat changes, lowers speed by one stage.

REJUVENATION.Description: The user revives a party Pokémon that has fainted and restores them to their max HP.
